jiraconfig.offEverywhere: While this is off, Jira appears nowhere else in the app — no links, no captions, nothing to click.
jiraconfig.refusals: Reading only: nothing is written back to Jira, nothing syncs on a schedule, no items are created from issues, and no organization is ever added to the map by Jira.

droppedStatuses.one: 1 saved status no longer means anything here. It was left out rather than guessed at — open the Jira reader and pick it again.
droppedStatuses.other: {count} saved statuses no longer mean anything here. They were left out rather than guessed at — open the Jira reader and pick them again.

jiraconfig.enableHint: Off until you say so. Turning it on makes the links appear; it starts nothing and writes nothing.
jiraconfig.savedHere: The mapping, the query and the on/off switch are saved for this workspace when you press Save, so you do not lose the picking. Saving them is not connecting: it changes nothing in Jira and creates nothing here.
jiraconfig.errSingleton: There is one Jira configuration for this workspace, and something tried to write a second. Reload the page and save again.
jiraconfig.errBadSiteUrl: That is not a usable site address. It must start with https:// and name your Jira site — the shape is https://yoursite.atlassian.net, with nothing after it.
jiraconfig.errFieldTooLong: That is too long to be a Jira field id. A field id is a short word or a customfield_ number, not a sentence.
jiraconfig.errJqlTooLong: That query is too long to save. Shorten it — the saved query is a sample to check the mapping against, not a whole report.
jiraconfig.errStatusMapShape: The saved status mapping is not in a shape this app can read. Pick your statuses again on the Jira reader and save.
